body.name: Auditable two-node \(C^2\) Morse instance
body.construction: Set \(n=2\), \(k=2\), \(m=1\), \(G_0\) empty, \(f_0=\mathrm{id}\), \(p_0^{\mathrm{obs}}=q_1^0=q_2^0=1\), and \(q_i^1(t)=Z_i^{-1}\exp\{b_i(1-\cos t)\}\), where \(0<b_1<b_2<1\) and \(Z_i=\int_{\mathbb T}\exp\{b_i(1-\cos t)\}d\lambda(t)\). Thus \(r_i'(t)=b_i\sin t\), \(Z_i=\{0,\pi\}\), and \(|r_i''(z)|=b_i\) at both critical points. Let \(\theta_0=(G_0,p_0,q_0,\mathrm{id})\). For \(0<h<R_0/2\), set \(\alpha_h(r)=\tau h\eta(r^2/h^2)\), \(\Psi_h(x)=\operatorname{Rot}(\alpha_h(|x|))x\) on \(|x|<h\), and the identity outside the chart; define \(\theta_h=(G_0,p_0,q_0,\Psi_h^{-1})\).
